meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 处理 git 时会先判断你要提交、整理历史还是查记录,再打印仓库的提交风格和拆分计划,把改动拆成多个原子提交,而不是一次性全部提交。
howto.when: 任何 git 操作都会触发:你说「commit」「rebase」,或问某行代码是谁写的、哪次提交引入的等。

say.note: 先分析提交风格,再拆成多个提交

say.text: 把最近几个提交合并整理一下
say.note: 走 rebase 流程清理本地历史
用 blame 定位提交和作者

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude first detects whether you want a commit, a history rewrite, or a history lookup, prints the repo's commit style and a split plan, then commits changes as multiple atomic commits instead of one.
howto.when_en: Triggers on any git operation: say "commit" or "rebase", or ask who wrote a line or which commit introduced a change.

say_en.note: Analyzes repo style, then splits into several commits

say_en.text: Squash and tidy my recent commits
say_en.note: Runs a rebase to clean up local history
Uses blame to find the exact commit and author
